QuestInfo.name: Voice Soother
QuestInfo.1: A marvelous hero like yourself needs an amazing voice to speak to the people. It's said that the #o2400001# has a dewdrop that will make your throat sing. Go to #m400030100# and obtain the #t4033431#.
QuestInfo.2: It tastes horrible, but you are singing like a REAL idol now... unnaturally and a little bit flat.

0.0: #h0#, stop shaking the goods around all these chumps and let me lay something out for you. You're not talking like a hero and that is a poor representation of me. \r\n#L0##bWh-what? I wasn't shaking my goods!#l\n#k
0.1: I SAW GOOD-SHAKING. You can work on that sultry saunter of yours later. You need a better voice! It seriously sounds like two cats trying to get out of a sack whenever you talk.\r\n#L0##bEskalade. I swear I am going to turn you into a pair of shoes...#l\n#k
0.2: Hey, sweetie... it's just one dragon's opinion! Your voice is important! That's why I'm gonna help you out.

yes.0: What YOU need is a good batch of #t4033431# goo. It's going to taste like three month old toe fungus, but TRUST ME. That stuff works miracles when you've got a voice like an old sea hag.

no.0: Oh, don't be such a crybaby. Try it out!

1.0: Did you get enough?\r\n#L0##bDo I have to drink this? It's all... sticky.#l\n#k
1.1: Just close your eyes and knock it back.\r\n#L0##bUgh, it's all oogy! Bleh! #l\n#k
1.2: You shouldn't say that without even drinking it! Hurry up, drink it! People say healthy foods taste bad.

yes.0: See? That wasn't so bad! You sounds so much cuter now!

item.0: Go to the #m400030100#, beat up an #o2400001# or two, and bring back 10 #t4033431# vials.
